clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Age Requirements; applies to API and use of Services as part of an API Client.
clauses.condition_explanation: user_is_at_least_18 means the person using the APIs is at least 18 years old. api_client_not_directed_to_or_likely_accessed_by_under_18s means the Services are not used as part of a website, application, or other service directed toward or likely to be accessed by individuals under 18.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; applies to Google AI Studio and Gemini API use.
clauses.condition_explanation: professional_or_business_purpose_not_consumer_use means use is for developers building with Google AI models for professional or business purposes, and not for consumer use.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; region availability is specified by external Documentation. The Paid Services definition at lines 113–120 determines the relevant service classification.
clauses.condition_explanation: within_available_region means the Services are accessed, and any API Clients made available to users are made available, only within an available region. eea_switzerland_or_uk means the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or the United Kingdom. If API Clients are made available to users in any of those places, only Paid Services may be used. Paid Services classification depends on the conditions in lines 113–120.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; covers developing models that compete with Services and attempting to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate any Service component, including underlying data or models such as parameter weights.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to either competing-model development or an attempt to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate a Service component.

obligation_items.content: Do not develop models that compete with the Services or attempt to reverse engineer, extract, or replicate any component of the Services.
obligation_items.object: Services, including underlying data and models

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; incorporates the API Terms' API Prohibitions and the linked Prohibited Use Policy. Their substantive content is not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: comply_with_api_prohibitions_and_prohibited_use_policy means compliance with both the API Prohibitions section of the API Terms and the linked Prohibited Use Policy; their requirements cannot be determined from this chunk.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the API Terms' API Prohibitions and the Prohibited Use Policy.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; includes a prohibition on bypassing protective measures or using content violating the API Terms or Additional Terms, plus a safety-settings responsibility and a review/approval caveat for less restrictive settings.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if either protective measures are bypassed or content violating the referenced terms is used. The separate responsibility to determine necessary and appropriate safety settings and factuality tools is stated as a duty, but cannot be represented as a distinct activity in the supplied activity vocabulary. Google review and approval may apply to applications with less restrictive safety settings; no approval outcome is supplied.

obligation_items.content: Do not attempt to bypass protective measures or use content that violates the API Terms or Additional Terms.
obligation_items.object: Services and content used with the Services

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use Restrictions; bars the stated medical and regulated uses of the Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies if use is in clinical practice, to provide medical advice, or in any manner overseen by or requiring clearance or approval from a medical device regulatory agency.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the Services in clinical practice, to provide medical advice, or in a manner overseen by or requiring medical-device regulatory clearance or approval.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Use of Generated Content; the applicable-law duty is stated to be required by the API Terms. Attribution may be required by applicable law when generated content is returned as part of an API call. User discretion and responsibility statements are also included.
clauses.condition_explanation: The operative compliance duty is to comply with applicable law in using generated content, including attribution only where applicable law requires it. The API Terms are external and not supplied. The text also assigns responsibility for the licensee's use and for use by recipients with whom content is shared, without specifying a separately expressible activity duty.

obligation_items.content: Comply with applicable law when using generated content, including providing attribution to users when applicable law requires it for content returned as part of an API call.
obligation_items.trigger: When using generated content; attribution is required only when applicable law requires it in the stated API-call context.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes Google's use of submitted content and generated responses, subject to the linked Privacy Policy. This is a provider data-processing commitment, not a licensee activity permission or duty expressible with the supplied activities.
clauses.condition_explanation: unpaid_service_use includes Google AI Studio and unpaid Gemini API quota. The stated purposes are to provide, improve, and develop Google products, services, and machine-learning technologies, including enterprise features. The linked Privacy Policy is not supplied.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; expressly directs users not to submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to Unpaid Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: unpaid_service_use means use of an Unpaid Service, including Google AI Studio or unpaid Gemini API quota. The prohibition applies to submission of any sensitive, confidential, or personal information.

obligation_items.content: Do not submit sensitive, confidential, or personal information to Unpaid Services.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes an extension of the license granted to Google under the API Terms' Submission of Content section. The incorporated grant and its operative scope are not supplied, so no permission or duty is inferred.
clauses.condition_explanation: The extension applies to the extent required under applicable law for Google's use and covers submitted content, including examples of prompts, associated system instructions, cached content, and files, as well as generated responses. The API Terms' underlying license is missing.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; describes Google's purpose limitation and retention/deletion behavior for tuning content. These provider data-handling statements do not map to an available activity without inventing one.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated use is only for the express tuning purpose. Tuning content may be retained with tuned models for re-tuning when supported models change, and related tuning content is deleted when the tuned model is deleted.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Unpaid Services, How Google Uses Your Data; for users in the EEA, Switzerland, or UK, the Paid Services data-use terms apply to all Services, including otherwise unpaid Google AI Studio and Gemini API quota. The referenced Paid Services section is at lines 128–153.
clauses.condition_explanation: user_in_eea_switzerland_or_uk means the user is in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, or United Kingdom. This clause incorporates the Paid Services data-use provisions; it does not itself specify a distinct user action or additional data duty.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services; defines when access is treated as a Paid Service, a classification used by other terms rather than an independent permission or obligation.
clauses.condition_explanation: A fee-offered Service is Paid. Google AI Studio access is also Paid when the account has access to a Cloud Project with an associated active Cloud Billing account or is a Workspace enterprise account, even if offered free. Gemini API access is Paid only through a Cloud Project associated with an active billing account.

clauses.scope_note: Gemini API Additional Terms, Paid Services; cross-reference defining which Google entity the term Google denotes. The referenced entity definition is external and not supplied.
clauses.condition_explanation: For Paid Services, Google has the meaning in the linked Google Cloud Terms entity definition. This definition supplies context only and does not itself create a behavioral rule.
